questions.question: When should we arrive in Prague?
questions.answer: We recommend arriving three days before the wedding to adjust to the time change

questions.question: Will roundtrip transportation be provided for the symbolic ceremony to the celebration?
questions.answer: Yes, please RSVP to register for transportation. Transportation will run on a strict schedule. Please be on the look out for more details closer to the date.

questions.question: Can I explore the Karlštejn castle after the ceremony?
questions.answer: Yes. You will have 2 hours to explore the castle after the ceremony. If you take your own transportation you can leave as you please, however those using the bus will have time to explore for set amount of time.

questions.question: What are the accommodation options?
questions.answer: We recommend the following accommodations for a more affordable option.

questions.question: Is there public transportation to the ceremony and the party?
questions.answer: Yes. To the Karlštejn castle, there is a direct 30-minute train from Smíchovské Nádraží. To the party, there is a 10-minute bus from the metro stop Opatov. It takes over 1 and half hours to go from Karlštejn to the party using public transportation, while 1 hour by bus. If you prefer to use the bus we will rent out, with direct transportation to both please RSVP through your link.

questions.question: Are gifts expected?
questions.answer: Your presence is the greatest gift. For those who would like to give something, we have created [a registry](https://www.myregistry.com/wedding-registry/david-miloschewsky-and-gypsy-alvarado-covarrubias-/5685209).

questions.question: Are children invited?
questions.answer: To help us create a peaceful and intimate atmosphere during our symbolic ceremony and dinner party, we kindly ask to make childcare arrangements for young children. If unable to do so, please be prepared to step outside with your little ones if needed. Thank you for your understanding!

questions.question: Will the ceremony be outdoors?
questions.answer: The dinner party will take place outdoors under a tent. We recommend being ready for rain or sunshine as weather fluctuates.

questions.question: When should I book my flight?
questions.answer: The earlier the better. We recommend using google flights to find good deals.
